chose: Scope as a deterministic server-side SVG projection: scope-model.ts -> scope.json -> render-scope.ts -> _scope.html, with the write path (human marks) as the primary product and the canvas as its addressing scheme
over: a client-side interactive canvas library with browser-side layout
a second visual/light vocabulary beside panel.ts's Light/LightKind and render-index.ts's grid constants
a separate .coherence/marks/ ledger beside the decision journal
because: docs --check byte-compares generated artifacts with zero normalization, so any layout that is not a pure function of the graph turns the drift gate into a noise generator; and index-model.ts already names the failure mode Scope would repeat (four complete artifacts that go unread). Written up in SCOPE-CLAUDE-TAKE.md; no implementation.

chose: gate totality on a NAMED enumeration the code owns: the chokepoint when it is a data symbol, else an explicit `over <ENUMERATION>`; a function/method/class is refused
over: asking the author (or the model) to classify the claim as closed- or open-domain
a deny-list of callable kinds, which would let an unseen language pack's capture pass a predicate through silently
letting `via guard` stay exempt, which is where the unbackable claims were sitting
because: Measured in mnemion: 15 oracles named '...totality', anchored to two incompatible things. SENSITIVE_COLUMNS is a const the code owns — finite, finishable. isBlockedFederationHost is a predicate ending in `return false` — no enumeration exists and every unrecognised host encoding is admitted by construction. Both rendered green in the same words. A model authoring a claim cannot be asked which kind it is (self-classification is the same failure one level up, and the self-verification literature measures it), so the grammar decides on SHAPE instead. Result: 11 of mnemion's claims go red including SSRF, while the 5 const-anchored ones pass untouched.

chose: add `coverage "<subject>" at <chokepoint> residual "<what is NOT covered>"` as the honest verb for an open domain, with the residual enforced by the REGEX
over: letting an open-domain claim keep the boundary verb with a weaker oracle
making residual an optional field, which reproduces green-by-absence at the field level
because: An open-domain claim is not a defect — SSRF filtering is legitimate and necessary; shipping it as 'totality' is the defect. So the verb must exist or the gate just deletes honest work. Its price is the residual: COVERAGE_RE will not match without one. It also buys something real — the live-domain meta-oracle is deliberately NOT run for coverage, because demanding live-domain iteration from a claim that has announced it samples is incoherent. Before this, `via guard` was a FREE exemption from that analysis; coverage is a PRICED one. mnemion already writes these residuals ('a public hostname whose DNS resolves to a private IP cannot be caught here') in source comments, where no gate sees them and no render shows them to whoever trusts the green.
